intro: North Korea covers the northern part of the Korean Peninsula and is mostly mountains.

chapters.title: Mountains and rivers
text: Mount Paektu, a volcano on the Chinese border, is the highest peak at 2,744 m and is sacred in Korean legend. The Yalu and Tumen rivers form the border with China, and a short border with Russia.
The Demilitarized Zone separates North and South.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Winters are long and very cold, summers hot and rainy. Floods and droughts have damaged harvests.

keyTerms.meaning: The Demilitarized Zone, a guarded strip between the two Koreas.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of North Korea's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.

items.name: Mount Paektu
items.text: A crater lake on the Chinese border.
